ASM_RESPONSE_LOGIN
Description
This event is triggered for a request that matched a login page URL in the policy
and was actually handled as a login attempt.
Examples
This
example
displays
logged_in
status
of
a
user
for
an
ASM
request.
when
ASM_REQUEST_DONE
{
set
is_in_login
0
if
{[
ASM
::
login_status
]
eq
"logging_in"
}
{
set
is_in_login
1
}
}
when
ASM_RESPONSE_LOGIN
{
log
local0.
"User [ASM::username] tried to log in and status is [ASM::login_status]."
}
when
ASM_RESPONSE_VIOLATION
{
if
{
$is_in_login
eq
1
}
{
log
local0.
"User [ASM::username] tried to log in and status is [ASM::login_status]."
}
}
